source_evidence.readme: The original demo README states that the right-hand HUD button brings up the load/save box and adjusts volume.
source_evidence.service_button: NBUT2 is the source-proven right-hand OPTIONS/SERVICE HUD control.
source_evidence.close_inference: No separate close control exists in SAVE06..SAVE13; the same OPTIONS hotspot remains exposed while the panel is open. Therefore the right-hand OPTIONS control is used as an open/close toggle.
source_evidence.escape_rule: ESC is documented as Skip Response for conversations and is not assigned to service-menu close.

runtime_rules: left click OPTIONS while closed opens the service menu
left click the same OPTIONS hotspot while open closes the service menu
right mouse button does not close the service menu
opening stable visual is SAVE06, not SAVE13
hover visuals use SAVE07 through SAVE11 according to action
SAVE confirmation uses SAVE12 and LOAD confirmation uses SAVE13
closing clears pending service action/volume state and resumes gameplay
timing_boundary: SAVE00..SAVE06 ordering is source-proven. Exact 1996 frame timing is still HOLD and is not guessed by v149.
